text:
sam: Promo blocked. postsubmit job `artifact-push` failing with repeated 504s to S3 endpoint, deploy-bot put promo on hold.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: artifact upload error (504) attempts=4/4 state=hold

eva: Which artifact? frontend or infra? Any logs?

sam: frontend `web-client-2026.4.1.tgz`. Runners fail on PUT finalize. Logs show `504 Gateway Timeout` and `connection reset`.

jen: CI runners are stuck retrying and backing off, eating credits. We should manual-promote last-good `sha:ff1122` to keep change window.

eva: Agreed. Manual promote and file infra ticket. We'll re-run upload later with lower concurrency.

deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by @jen. Command: `/deploybot promote --sha ff1122 --env prod --reason "artifact upload 504"`

sam: Running the promote and adding note to release doc.

deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded: sha ff1122 promoted to prod at 2026-04-01T11:05:00Z

sam: Monitoring post-promote metrics. No regressions so far. Follow-ups: infra postmortem and retry plan for artifact upload (reduce parallelism + smaller chunk size).

eva: I'll own the retry and coordinate with storage team. Updating release notes and pinging PMs. :thumbsup:
